key_concepts: Annotate COMP documents and organizes networks with colored rectangles, user text, graphics, grouping, and optional viewers.
The built-in forms are Comment, Network Box, and full Annotate mode, each with different editing and grouping behavior.
The default setup combines internal nodes and an extension to provide text editing, network-box behavior, and node-viewing features.
OP Viewer controls can show and optionally interact with an embedded operator viewer inside the annotation.
Utility and layer-zone settings affect search inclusion and whether the annotate appears below the grid, between grid and nodes, or above nodes.
common_gotchas: Comments, Network Boxes, and full Annotates are built-in forms of Annotate COMP with different behavior.
The default setup's rich features come from internal nodes and an extension, not only from bare component parameters.
Locked annotates pass clicks through to the network body; use the title bar or RMB menu for management.
With Enclose Operators on, dragging the annotate moves enclosed nodes unless using the alternate drag behavior.
Enter and zoom-to-enter are disabled for Annotates; use Jump Down, path navigation, or the parameter dialog node menu.
build_relevance: 2021.10000+ network documentation, grouping, and embedded viewers
